boards.title: Your First Weekend at Susquehanna University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence for learning the campus, finding activity options and spending time in documented public-facing spaces.

cards.title: Start by getting your bearings at the Deg
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus-life hub
cards.notes: Use the Degenstein Center as a first meet-up point, then note its eateries, coffee spots and student-facing spaces before splitting up.
cards.short_summary: A central first stop for orienting a new group to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna identifies the Charles B. Degenstein Campus Center as the heart of campus life and lists multiple eateries and coffee spots there.
cards.access_notes: Confirm individual venue access and operating details on arrival.

cards.title: Make a plan over a meal at Evert
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Degenstein Campus Center
cards.notes: If your dining access is active, meet at Evert and compare weekend plans; it is one of the dining locations in the campus center.
cards.short_summary: A straightforward meal stop before choosing the rest of the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The university lists Evert Dining Hall among the eateries in the Charles B. Degenstein Campus Center.
cards.access_notes: Use an active meal plan or confirm guest-payment options and service times directly with dining.

cards.title: Set up a quiet reset at Blough-Weis Library
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · library and study spaces
cards.notes: Find a collaboration area for a short planning session, or take a solo break among the library’s study spaces before the next stop.
cards.short_summary: A designated study-and-collaboration stop on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Blough-Weis Library has study and collaboration spaces for more than 500 students and houses Scholarly Grounds Café and a film-viewing theater.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current access and service hours before heading over.

cards.title: See what’s on view at Lore Degenstein Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Degenstein Center, Upper Level
cards.notes: Walk through the current exhibition, then use the exhibition labels as an easy conversation starter with people you just met.
cards.short_summary: A free on-campus art stop with regularly changing exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Lore Degenstein Gallery presents four exhibitions each academic year; its events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 11 a.m.–5 p.m. daily; the gallery closes during university breaks.

cards.title: Take a daylight loop at the CEER Field Station
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · immediately adjacent to campus
cards.notes: Choose a daylight walk or bike outing on the field station trails, and keep the first outing simple while you learn the campus edge.
cards.short_summary: An adjacent outdoor field station with walking and biking trails.
cards.evidence_claim: The 87-acre CEER Field Station is immediately adjacent to campus and includes walking and biking trails, research plots and a greenhouse.
cards.access_notes: Go in daylight and verify trail conditions or any site-specific access guidance before setting out.

cards.title: Turn a campus walk into a tree-map scavenger hunt
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · across campus
cards.notes: Open the university’s tree map and pick a few tagged trees to locate together; it adds a purpose to a slow campus walk.
cards.short_summary: A map-guided way to explore hundreds of mapped campus trees.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna’s Campus Arboretum Initiative uses GIS to identify, tag and map hundreds of trees across campus.
cards.access_notes: Use the linked tree map and stay on normal campus paths.

cards.title: Check out the Garrett Sports Complex
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · recreation and athletics
cards.notes: Stop by to see the indoor track, pool, gym and fitness facilities, then ask about the current student recreation or intramural options.
cards.short_summary: A single campus complex that groups major recreation facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Garrett Sports Complex includes an aquatic center, gymnasium, fitness center and weight room, racquetball courts, indoor track and student lounge.
cards.access_notes: Facility use and schedules can vary; confirm student access and recreation hours before participating.

cards.title: Look for a River Hawk game or recreation event
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · campus athletics venues
cards.notes: Check the current schedule for a home contest, or use the recreation listings to find a social activity that fits your group’s energy.
cards.short_summary: A schedule-led option for seeing campus sports in action.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna fields 23 NCAA Division III varsity sports and offers intramural and recreational sports including soccer, basketball and volleyball.
cards.access_notes: Check the official athletics or recreation schedule for the specific event, location, admission and start time.

cards.title: See whether a performance is on at Stretansky
cards.subtitle: Saturday night · Cunningham Center for Music & Art
cards.notes: Browse the current arts calendar, then attend a listed music program if its timing and ticket details work for your group.
cards.short_summary: A named 320-seat performance venue in the Cunningham Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Stretansky Concert Hall is Susquehanna’s premier performance space and is a 320-seat venue designed for music performance.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current arts calendar; some university arts events require tickets.

cards.title: Close the weekend with a Weber Chapel event
cards.subtitle: Sunday · lectures, performances or chapel services
cards.notes: Check the event calendar for a guest lecture, visiting-artist program or chapel service, and pick one that feels welcoming for your group.
cards.short_summary: A large campus venue used for lectures, performances and chapel services.
cards.evidence_claim: Weber Chapel seats 1,500 and hosts guest lectures, visiting-artist performances and chapel services.
cards.access_notes: Consult the university events calendar for the specific program’s timing, admission and attendance guidance.
